item.title: Vidalux 7 Oct · FAQ carousel plug-in
item.description:
Can I just plug my infrared sauna in?
For most of our infrared saunas, yes. The 1-3 Person Solara, Solara 4 Person Corner, Premier (up to 3 Person) and Platinum (1-4 Person) run from a standard 3-pin socket. No electrician needed, just a socket, and each one is controlled from the cabin's own panel.
Larger infrared, traditional, hybrid and outdoor saunas are wired in by a Part P certified electrician instead. Worth knowing: the Solara 4 Person Corner plugs in, the 4 Person Solara does not.
See the plug-and-play range... link in bio. Save this for later.
#Vidalux #InfraredSauna #HomeSauna #UKHomes #SaunaAtHome #WellnessAtHome
